title: Three Tiny Habits That Improve Focus
description: A short, practical guide to improving focus with small daily habits.

scenes.heading: Protect your first 20 minutes
scenes.body: Begin important work before opening messages. Your attention is freshest before the day becomes reactive.

scenes.heading: Make distraction inconvenient
scenes.body: Put the phone in another room and close every tab that is unrelated to the current task.

scenes.heading: Stop while the next step is clear
scenes.body: End each session by writing one sentence that tells your future self exactly where to resume.
